contents.name: Wall flux methods, positivity-preserving limiting, and fully discrete time integration
contents.reason: The selected periodic branch proves semidiscrete entropy and a separate guarded fixed-grid forward-Euler error estimate; no discrete wall flux, unconditional positivity, or fully discrete entropy theorem is asserted.
